title: Hydroclimate dry-down / ET coupling
simLoop: Insolation and lagged cover drive moisture-limited ET partitions; vegetation captures more water but also transpires more; south aspects dry faster than north under identical rain.
gameLoop: After rain stops, the world dries unevenly — wet hollows and vegetated patches read differently from bare south slopes without an inspector.
notebookSeed: The south slope dried first; the vegetated hollow kept drinking after the rain stopped.
tierO: no owner-only question; deferred — after the rain stopped, did the place feel like it was drying itself, or like a slider was turned down? (batch with §4.0 step 6)
